rows.author: F100;
rows.title_full: RESOLUTION EXPRESSING THE RECOGNITION OF ANDRES BONIFACIO AS THE FIRST PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES AND URGING THE PRESIDENT TO INSTITUTE THROUGH THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION AND COMMISSION ON HIGHER EDUCATION SIGNIFICANT MEASURES TO DISSEMINATE AND PROPAGATE THE TRUTH ABOUT SUCH FACT IN HISTORY BOOKS, ELEMENTARY, HIGH SCHOOL AND TERTIARY EDUCATION, AND OTHER RELATED MEDIUM OF INFORMATION
rows.status: Referred to Stakeholders on 2014-03-20

committee_action.remarks: The National Historical Commission of the Philippines submitted their position to the Committee, to wit: "ON THE ISSUE OF BONIFACIO AS FIRST PRESIDENT, THE BOARD OF THE COMMISSION RECOGNIZES THE REPUBLIC ESTABLISHED IN MALOLOS AS THE FIRST REPUBLIC, WITH A CONSTITUTION DULY APPROVED BY THE MALOLOS CONGRESS, AND EMILIO AGUINALDO AS PRESIDENT. WHILE THE KATIPUNAN HAS ITS INTERNAL STRUCTURE, LEADERS, AND MEMBERS, IT DID NOT EXIST AS A GOVERNMENT OF A STATE. WE DO RECOGNIZE THE IMPORTANT ROLE OF ANDRES BONIFACIO IN THE PROCESS OF NATION BUILDING THOUGH NOT NECESSARILY AS THE FIRST PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC. ANDRES BONIFACIO, IS A NATIONAL HERO, THOUGH NOT THE 'NATIONAL HERO' - AN HONOR THAT BELONGS TO JOSE RIZAL, WHOM BONIFACIO, THE KATIPUNAN AND THE FIRST REPUBLIC REGARDED WITH THE HIGHEST ESTEEM. NOVEMBER 30 OF THE YEAR IS ALREADY A NATIONAL HOLIDAY IN HONOR OF BONIFACIO AND HIS SACRIFICE FOR OUR PEOPLE. (Sgd. Dr. Maria Serena I. Diokno, Chairperson)
